articles.title: Alcaraz responds to a marriage proposal in the middle of an interview: "I'm still too young"'
articles.standfirst: A fan shouted from the stands of London's O2 Arena asking him to marry her sister
articles.summary: A fan shouted from the stands of London's O2 Arena asking him to marry her sister
articles.body:
Carlos Alcaraz stirs passions wherever he goes and is the tennis player most loved by tennis fans. Further proof of this came on Saturday night at London’s O2 Arena during the second day of the 2026 Laver Cup.

While the man from Murcia was listening to one of the host's questions, former tennis player Sam Querrey, he heard a shout from the stands. "Marry my sister, Carlitos! " To which the genius from El Palmar replied: " I'm still too young ," always with a smile on his face.

Federer and Murray's laughter

Alcaraz was so distracted by the surprising request from one of the front rows of the O2 that he had to ask the interviewer to repeat the question. Roger Federer and Andy Murray , present in the arena, could not stop laughing at the seven-time Grand Slam champion's response.
